text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Table: cut 170 x 126 mm from 12 mm steel plate; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 20.5 mm hole in the centre (85 and 63 mm from the edges).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw: cut 150 mm of Tr20 x 4 lead screw, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push the screw into the hole flush with the table top. Clamp it square

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the table with an engineer's square both ways.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld a 5 mm fillet all round underneath; plug weld the top and grind

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it flush and flat. Keep weld spatter off the thread.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the screw runs down through the handwheel nut, the thrust washer,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 25 mm hole in the base plate and the hole in the bench.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The table's back edge runs 2 mm in front of the column face; the column

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stops the table turning when the handwheel turns.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the screw is square to the table within 0.2 mm over 100 mm.
